data.name: Dummy!
data.detailed_description:
Oferta especial


Acerca do jogo



Which of you is the most erudite? Do you think that you know a certain topic better than your friends? Welcome to Dummy! Here you can find out whether you really believe in yourself.


Gather a group of friends for up to 10 people, choose the interesting question pack with the necessary topics and compete, collecting points that will bring you victory!


Create question packs. An intuitive editor for creating questions will allow you to create really interesting topics! Then share the questions you created with other players in the Steam Workshop.


Find rivals online. There will always be a person who will put your knowledge into question!

reviews.review:
Dummy! is a free-to-play multiplayer trivia game developed and published by Toxic Dog that focuses on bringing friends and online competitors together through fast-paced quiz competitions. Instead of relying on action mechanics or complex gameplay systems, the experience revolves around answering questions from a wide variety of categories while competing for the highest score. Its concept is intentionally simple, making it easy for newcomers to jump in while still offering enough variety to entertain dedicated trivia fans. Whether players enjoy movies, music, gaming, history, science, or general knowledge, the game encourages them to put their memory and quick thinking to the test in a friendly competitive environment.

The heart of the experience is its multiplayer mode, where up to ten players can participate in the same trivia session. Every match becomes a race to answer accurately while staying ahead of the competition, creating an enjoyable mix of strategy and knowledge. The accessible controls and intuitive interface mean that nearly anyone can participate regardless of gaming experience, making it an excellent choice for casual gatherings or online game nights. Because success depends on knowledge instead of reflexes, every participant has a genuine opportunity to perform well, keeping matches fair and engaging.

One of the game's most appealing features is its support for custom content. Dummy! includes a built-in editor that allows players to design their own question packs, giving them the freedom to create quizzes centered on virtually any subject they can imagine. These creations can then be uploaded and shared through the Steam Workshop, allowing the community to continually expand the game's available content. This feature greatly improves replay value since players are not limited to the official questions. Communities can build quizzes tailored to specific fandoms, educational topics, local culture, or private events, ensuring that fresh material continues to appear over time.

Online matchmaking also adds another layer of longevity by allowing players to compete against opponents beyond their own group of friends. Facing unfamiliar competitors introduces different knowledge strengths and exposes players to a wider variety of custom quizzes. The constantly changing selection of community-created content helps each session feel different, particularly for players who enjoy discovering new categories or challenging themselves with increasingly specialized trivia packs.

Visually, Dummy! adopts a clean and practical presentation that prioritizes readability above flashy effects. Menus are easy to navigate, questions are displayed clearly, and the overall interface minimizes distractions so players can remain focused on answering quickly. The audio presentation complements the casual atmosphere without becoming intrusive, resulting in an experience that feels polished despite its straightforward design philosophy. The emphasis remains firmly on the gameplay rather than elaborate graphics, which suits the genre well.

Although the game offers plenty of replayability through multiplayer and community-generated content, its long-term appeal naturally depends on an active player base and a steady flow of new quizzes. Players who rely only on the default question packs may eventually encounter repeated content, while those who embrace custom creations will find considerably more variety. Likewise, individuals seeking a story-driven experience or deep progression systems may discover that Dummy! intentionally favors quick social entertainment over long-term single-player objectives.

Overall, Dummy! succeeds as an accessible and entertaining trivia platform that emphasizes creativity, competition, and community participation. The combination of multiplayer support, user-generated quizzes, Steam Workshop integration, and approachable gameplay makes it a solid option for players looking to enjoy lighthearted knowledge-based competition. Its greatest strength lies in allowing the community to continually refresh the experience with original content, helping the game remain enjoyable well beyond its initial offerings.

Rating: 6/10
